value.rationale: A robust explicit counterexample separates compensatory isolated recruitment from simple coupled dynamics. In contrast to a cycle created at a loss of stability of the synchronized equilibrium, here neither attractor excludes the other and both have open basins at the same parameters. Exact rational margins and the constant-dispersal control make this a useful reproducible mechanism witness without requiring a full bifurcation classification.
